B6 is the subject and this MSP discharges it. mitosis-gate.mjs now imports compileWorkflow from ./workflow-sandbox.mjs and calls it from compileUnderSandbox, which runMitosisGate invokes as a precondition of extractPhaseSurfaces, so the harness has a non-test caller; tests/dead-export-lint.test.mjs now counts the defining module over string-, comment-, template- and regex-masked source via scanJsStructure while counting .claude/workflows/mitosis.js and the sibling lib modules raw and excluding tests/ entirely, so compileWorkflow's two TypeError message strings no longer vouch for it and the census read it dead at 03e67fe until the gate caller landed at 3940f29; and .github/workflows/test.yml runs node .claude/lib/superpowers-parallel/mitosis-gate.mjs phase-parity in the test job, so the caller executes on every push and pull request rather than merely existing

this change edits .github/workflows/test.yml, the file that carries the invariant-coverage job the M1 gate runs, so it bears on the mechanism: the edit appends exactly one run step to the test job and leaves the invariant-coverage job byte-unchanged, which the single-added-line, zero-removed-line diff on that file shows; docs/invariants/registry.json and scripts/invariant-coverage-check.mjs are not edited; and this file is the coverage artifact itself, recorded in the repo rather than in the PR body, which pr-create could not carry in any case since its flag set is closed and its values are capped at 200 characters

the dead-export lint is a gate that classifies identifiers and this MSP rewrites its counting rule, so it must stay a closed census that halts on the unclassifiable: maskedOrHalt asserts scanJsStructure returned ok for every lib module and fails naming the module and the scan error otherwise, ownModuleCount asserts the masked occurrence count is not below the declaration count and fails naming the export when a declaration appears to sit inside a literal, and the census asserts deepEqual(dead, []) which names every offender rather than pinning a number; the surviving numeric assertion is the tripwire floor allExports.length >= 50, a floor and not a pinned count; on the gate side compileUnderSandbox is fail-closed, returning halt() and exiting GATE_COMPILE_EXIT rather than proceeding to a phase claim it cannot ground

the receipt is the dead-export census and it was executed red before the fix in its own commit: at 03e67fe node --test tests/dead-export-lint.test.mjs reported tests 3 pass 2 fail 1 with the assertion naming workflow-sandbox.mjs :: compileWorkflow as the sole dead export, and at 3940f29 the same command reported tests 3 pass 3 fail 0, so the fix commit's parent is exactly the red state; both inertness mutations were run on a scratch copy outside the repo and observed, not assumed: reverting the defining module to raw counting turned the masker row red with 3 !== 0 and, with the caller also reverted to its pre-3940f29 state, made the census pass vacuously despite compileWorkflow having zero callers, and deleting the .replace(ESM_EXPORT_PREFIX, '') normalization turned the compile row red with workflow source failed to compile in the sandbox: Unexpected token 'export'

the range contains both a refactor and a behavior change and they are separated into distinct commits: 40c6188 replaces every variable-built RegExp in the file, in resolveCallSitePhases and in countIdentifierTokens and collectKeyOccurrences, with masked-source scans and lands alone with no behavior delta, pinned by the 44 pre-existing tests in tests/mitosis-gate.test.mjs plus the sites === 0 characterization row added in the preceding commit a699086, which grep confirmed had no test before this MSP; the compile precondition lands separately as 3940f29; the surviving behavior across the refactor is proved by the gate suite reporting 45/45 identically on both sides and by the live-target row continuing to return clean against .claude/workflows/mitosis.js, and semgrep --config p/default --error now exits 0 on the file with no nosemgrep pragma added
